chunks: And it is narrated from Muʿammar ibn Khallād, who said:
A man asked al-Riḍā عليه السلام about storing food for a year. He said: "I do it."

key_terms.مُعَمَّرِ بْنِ خَلَّادٍ: Muʿammar ibn Khallād, the transmitter named in the report

ai.seo_question: Is storing food for a year permissible in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that a man asked Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام about keeping food stored for a year, and the Imam replied that he himself did so. The report indicates the permissibility of storing food for one’s household provision and distinguishes this from blameworthy hoarding.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3960 - It is narrated from Mu'ammar ibn Khallad that

a man asked Imam Ali ibn Musa Ar-Ridha (as), about storing food for a year.
Imam (as) replied: "I do it."
